Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 17
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly shifted the target organization from the Free Software Foundation (FSF) to the Free Software Foundation Europe (FSFE), conflating the two and ignoring the direct evidence from directory.fsf.org that the Free Software Directory is a project of the FSF. This misattribution led to naming Georg Greve (FSFE founder) instead of Richard Stallman (FSF founder) as the person who started the foundation behind the Directory.
